simple.meaning: כֹתֶרֶת (kôthereth) is a Hebrew word meaning “the capital of a column.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כֹתֶרֶת (H3805) appears 24 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Kings 7:16, with occurrences in 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֹתֶרֶת (H3805) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כֹתֶרֶת (H3805) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כֹתֶרֶת (kôthereth) / H3805 is traced through 1 Kings 7:16, 1 Kings 7:17, 1 Kings 7:18, 1 Kings 7:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He made two capitals of molten bronze, to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits,* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. and a capital of bronze was on it. definitions.full: H3805. kothereth כּוֺתֶ֫רֶת כֹּתֶ֫רֶת, noun feminine capital of pillar (as surrounding, crowning its top ?); — absolute כֹּתֶרֶת 1Kin 7:16 (twice in verse) + 10 t.; הַכּוֺתֶרֶת Jeremiah 52: ; plural absolute, כֹּתָרֹת 7:16 7 t., כֹּתָרוֺת 2Chr 4:12 (twice in verse); 4:13 ; — capitals of pillars יָכִין and בֹּעַז 1Kin 7:16 (3 t. in verse) + 12 t. 1 Kings 7 2Chr 4:12 (twice in verse); 4:13 ; 2Kin 25:17 (3 t. in verse) = Jer 52:22 (3 t. in verse).
